in_stock.title: Stock preference
in_stock.description: prefer: among equally close combinations pick one in stock; require: never land on an out-of-stock combination or option; ignore: stock does not matter.

tie_break.title: Tie-break between equally close options
tie_break.description: schema: the order of the options in the group; price_low / price_high: by the option's price delta; popularity: by the option's popularity.

partial.title: Partial selections
partial.description: fill: complete required groups with their default (else the best option); keep: leave groups the shopper has not chosen empty and report them as missing.

fallback.title: When the selection is not valid
fallback.description: closest: change as few picks as possible (the option just picked wins); defaults: keep the option just picked and reset the others to their defaults; reject: answer with a problem and the closest valid suggestion.

max_steps.title: Search budget (steps per resolution)
max_steps.description: Upper bound on the combinations the resolver explores; the best valid combination found within it is returned.

notify_when_out_of_stock.title: Notify-me hook
notify_when_out_of_stock.description: When the resolved combination is out of stock, include a notify object (item, variant, SKU) the page can pass to a back-in-stock alert form.
